a2.arrive.text: Oof. From out here the pasal looks even sadder.
Don't worry, nani. The best tea stall in Chiya Tole is right next door. You'll have help!

a2.shutter.text: A little oil, a big push... and!
It opens all the way! And it doesn't scream anymore!

a2.paint_facade.text: Oho! The neighbours will think we've become rich.
Rich in paint, Hajurama. That's a start.

a2.sign_board.text: I helped with the letters! The S is mine. It's a bit wobbly.
It's the best S in Kathmandu, Bhai.

a2.awning.text: Now my customers can wait for tea in your shade. Very good business, Maya!

a2.steps.text: No more tripping. Safe steps, happy customers.

a2.plants.text: Those are not for digging, Biralo!

a2.street_lamp.text: It works! I mean... of course it works. Kanchha Dai never fails.

a2.bench.text: A bench! Now the aunties will sit here all afternoon. You'll hear everything!

a2.upper_window.text: Fresh air in my room at last. Now I can watch the whole tole, hehe.

a2.string_lights.text: Didi, it looks like a festival!
Every evening can feel a little bit like one.

a2.bicycle.text: Ring ring! Delivery for Sunita Didi! One packet of Pudina!

a2.street.text: Maya swept the whole street? Even in front of MY stall?

a2.outro.text: Look at it! Customers are stopping just to take photos.
Your Hajurba would have made a speech. A long one.
There's just one thing. The storage room. Nobody has opened it in years.
I heard something scratching in there...
Then let's find out what's inside. Together!
